s: vya, nirarTakaH । tatparyyAyaH । muDA 2 vyarTakam 3 aviDiH 4 । ityamaraH ॥ yaTA, -- “adaRqapASiko grAmo adAsIkaYca yadgfham । anAjyaBojanaM yacca vfTA taditi me matiH ॥” iti vahnipurARe pretopAKyAnanAmADyAyaH ॥ api ca । “vfTA vfzwiH samudrasya tfptasya BojanaM vfTA । vfTA dAnaM samfdDasya nIcasya sukftaM vfTA ॥” iti gAruqe 115 aDyAyaH ॥
m: वृथा ind. (prob. connected with √ 2. वृ) at will, at pleasure, at random, easily, lightly, wantonly, frivolously, RV.; Br.; Gobh.; Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh.
in vain, vainly, uselessly, fruitlessly, idly, TBr. &c. &c. (with √ कृ, ‘to make useless’, disappoint, frustrate; with √ भू, ‘to be useless’, be disappointed or frustrated)
wrongly, falsely, incorrectly, unduly, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वृथा &c. See p. 1007, col. 3.
a: वृथा — ind. [वृ-थाल् किच्च] 1 To no purpose, in vain, uselessly, unprofitably; often with the force an adjective; व्यर्थं यत्र कपींद्रसख्यमपि मे वीर्यं हरीणां वृथा U. 3. 45; दिवं यदि प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः Ku. 5. 45. --2 Unnecessarily. --3 Foolishly, idly, wantonly. --4 Wrongly; improperly. (At the beginning of comp. वृथा may be translated by ‘vain, useless, improper, false, idle’ &c.). --Comp. --अक्ष्या strolling about idly, walking for pleasure. --आकारः a false form, an empty show. --कथा idle talk. --जन्मन् n. unprofitable or vain birth. --दानं a gift that may be revoked, or not made good if promised. --मति a. foolish-minded. --मांसं flesh not intended for the Gods or Manes. --वादिन् a. speaking falsely.

k.v: कदाचिज्जातु सार्धं तु साकं सत्रा समं सह। आनुकूल्यार्थकं प्राध्वं व्यर्थके तु वृथा मुधा॥

m: वृथा—भोग mfn. enjoying in vain or to no purpose, ib.
वृथा—छेद m. useless or frivolous cutting, Yājñ.
वृथा˚घात (˚थाघ्˚), m. striking uselessly, killing unnecessarily, W.
वृथा—श्रम m. vain exertion, useless labour, Pañcat.
वृथा˚चार (˚थाच्˚), m. frivolous or lawless in conduct, MBh.

s: klI, (vfTA nirarTakaM dAnam .) nizPaladAnam । tat zoqaSaviDam । yaTA, -- “devapitfvihInaM yadISvareByaH sadozataH । dattvAnukIrttanAccEva vedAgnivratatyAgine ॥ anTAbopArjjitaM dAnaM vyarTaM brahmahaRe taTA । gurave'nftavaktA yaH stenAya patitAya ca ॥ kftaGnAya ca yaddattaM sarvvadA brahmavidvize । pAcakAya ca sarvvasya vfzalyAH pataye taTA ॥ paricArakAya BftyAya sarvvatra piSunAya ca । ityetAni tu rAjendra vfTAdAnAni zoqaSa ॥” iti vahnipurARe dAnAvasTAnirRayanAmADyAyaH ॥ anyacca । nyAyamArgeRa yaddattaM tat saptaviDamapi punarnApaharttavyam । yat punaranyAyena dattaM tadadattaM zoqaSamapi pratyAharttavyameva । ityarTAduktaM Bavati । nAradena ca । “dattaM saptaviDaM proktamadattaM zoqaSAtmakam .” iti pratipAdya dattAdattayoH svarUpaM vivftam । “paRyamUlyaM BftistuzwyA snehAt pratyupakArataH । strISulkAnugrahArTaYca dattaM dAnavido viduH ॥ adattantu BayakroDaSokavegarujAnvitEH । taTotkocaparIhAsavyatyAsacCalayogataH ॥ bAlamUQAsvatantrArttamattonmattApavarjjitam । karttA mamedaM karmmeti pratilABecCayA ca yat ॥ apAtre pAtramityukte kAryye vA DarmmasaMhite । yaddattaM syAdavijYAnAdadattamiti tat smftam ॥” iti mitAkzarA ॥
v: na॰ karma॰ । 1 nizPaladAne smftipradarSite devapitrAdyarTaminnezu kAryyezu 2 dAnaBede ca । “devapitfvihInaM yadISvarerByaH svadozataH । dattvAmukIrtta nAccEva vedAgnivratatyAgine । anTAyopArjitaM dAka vyarTaM brahmahaRe taTA । gurave'nftavaktrAya stenAya patitAya ca । kftaGnAya ca yaddattaM sarvadA brahmavidvize । yAjakAya ca sarvasya vfzalyAHpataye taTA । paricArakAya nftyAva sarvatra piSunAya ca । ityetAni tu rAjendra! vfTAdAnAni zoqaSa” vahnipu॰ । “nyAyamArgeRa yadfttaM tatmaptaviDamapi punarnApaharttavyaM Tat punaranTAyena dattaM tadadattaM zoqaSaprakAramapi patyAharttavyameva ityarTAduktaM Bavati । nAradena ca dattaM saptaviDa--proktamadattaM zoqaSAtmakam” iti pratipAdya dattAdattayoH svarUpaM vivftaM yaTA “paRyamUlyaM BftistuzwyA snehAt pratyupakArataH । strISulkAnugrahArTaYca dattaM dAnavido viduH । adattantu BayakroDaSokavegarujAMnvitEH । taTotkocaparihAsavyatyAsa cCalayogataH । vAlamUQAsvatantrArttamattonmattApavarjitam । karttA mamedaM karmeti pratilABecCayA ca yat । apAtre pAtramityukte kAryye vA DarmasaMhite । yaddattaM syAdavijYAnAdadattamiti tat smftam” mitA॰ adattaSabde dfSyam ।
m: वृथा—दान n. a useless or improper gift (as a gift promised to courtesans, wrestlers &c.; accord. to some there are 16 kinds of these gifts), Mn. viii, 139.
वृथा˚ग्नि (˚थाग्नि), m. common fire, any fire, AV.; Prāyaśc.
वृथा—जात mfn. born in vain (i.e. ‘one who neglects the prescribed rites’), Mn. v, 89.

s: [n] klI, (vfTA nirarTakaM janma .) nirarTakajananam । yaTA, -- “vfTA janmAni catvAri vfTA dAnAni zoqaSa । tAnyahaM saMpravakzyAmi yaTAvadanupUrvvaSaH ॥ aputtrasya vfTA janma DarmmavAhyA narAH sadA । parapAkaM sadASvanti paratAparatASca ye ॥” ityAdye vahnipurARe dAnAvasTAnirRayanAmADyAyaH ॥ api ca । “yerna SrutaM BAgavataM purARaM nArADito yEH puruzaH praDAnam । muKe hutaM yErna DarAmarARAM tezAM vfTA janma narADamAnAm ॥” iti purARam ॥

m: वृथा—जन्मन् n. useless or unprofitable birth, MW.
वृथा˚कार (˚थाक्˚), m. a false form, empty show, Pañcat. i, 62 (others ‘one whose form is vain or illusory’).
वृथा—कथा f. idle talk, nonsense, W.
वृथा—कर्मन् n. an action done uselessly or for pleasure, non-religious act, Āpast.
वृथा—कृसर-संयाव m. a kind of food, (consisting of wheat-flour, rice and sesamum and prepared for no religious purpose), Mn. v, 7.
वृथा—कुल-समाचार mfn. one whose family and practices (or ‘family-practice’) are idle or low, MBh.
वृथा˚लम्भ (˚थाल्˚), m. cutting or plucking unnecessarily, Mn. xi, 144.
वृथा—लिङ्ग mf(आ)n. having no true cause, unsubstantiated, MBh.
वृथा—लिङ्गिन् mfn. one who wears a sectarian mark without any right to it, Viṣṇ.

s: klI, (vfTA nirarTakaM mAMsam .) devapitranuddizwamAMsam । tadBakzaRe pretatvaM Bavati । yaTA, “vfTAretA vfTAmAMso vfTAvAdI vfTAmatiH । nindako dvijadevAnAM sa preto jAyate naraH ॥” iti vahnipurARe pretopAKyAnanAmADyAyaH ॥
v: na॰ vfTABUtaM mAMsam SA॰ ka॰ । devAdyanuddeSena hatapaSUnAM mAMse ।
m: वृथा—मांस n. ‘flesh taken at random’ or ‘useless flesh’ (i.e. flesh not destined for the gods or Pitṛs but for one's own use only; the eater of such flesh is said to be born as a demon), ŚBr.; Mn.; Gaut. &c.
वृथा—मांस m. one who eats ‘useless’ flesh, MW.
वृथा—मति mfn. foolish-minded, wrong-minded, MBh.
वृथा˚न्न (˚थान्न), n. food for one's own use only, Kauś.; Gaut.
वृथा—पशु-घ्न mfn. one who kills cattle wrongly or unnecessarily (i.e. not for sacrifice), Mn. v, 38.
वृथा—पक्व mfn. cooked at random (i.e. only for one's own use), Gobh.
वृथा—पलित mfn. grown gray in vain, Śiś. (cf. -वृद्ध).
वृथा—प्रजा f. a woman who has borne children in vain, MārkP.
वृथा—प्रतिज्ञ mfn. one who makes a promise rashly, MW.
वृथा˚र्तवा (˚थार्त्˚), f. ‘one whose menstrual discharge is fruitless’, a barren woman, Gal.
वृथा—संकर-जात mfn. born in vain through the mixture of different castes (and hence neglectful in the performance of duties), MW.
वृथा—सुत mfn. pressed out in vain, Nir. xi, 4.
वृथा˚त्मायास (˚थात्म्˚), m. useless self-mortification, Nāg.
वृथा—त्व n. fruitlessness, futility, Sāh.
वृथा—वाच् f. frivolous or untrue speech, AitĀr.; Gobh.
वृथा—वादिन् mfn. speaking falsely or untruly, Pañcad.
वृथा—वृद्ध mfn. grown old in vain (i.e. without growing wise), Bālar. (cf. -पलित).
वृथा—व्रत n. a false religious observance, MBh.
वृथा—व्रत mfn. one who performs false r˚ ob˚, Hariv.
वृथा˚ट्या (˚थाट्या), f. strolling about in an idle manner, travelling for pleasure (regarded as a vice in a king), Mn. vii, 47.
वृथा—षह् (strong षाह्), mfn. one who easily overcomes or conquers, RV.
वृथक् ind. (prob.) = वृथा, RV. viii, 43, 4; 5 (Sāy. = पृथक्).
वृथोदक n. pl. water flowing at random (not in a channel), ŚBr.
वृथोद्यम mfn. exerting one's self in vain, BhP.
वृथोक्त mfn. spoken in vain, MārkP.
वृथोत्पन्न mfn. born or produced in vain, Mn. ix, 147.
